Isolated 1200-entry directory with 299 PNGs/4 folders; production positional launch and read-only entry/order/selection/scroll observer. 241 app tests pass serially; helper creates fixture and refuses overwrite. Native List scrolling validates 1260 movements; Grid/rename/resize remain unmeasured.

Strict scroll/postdraw validators; 62 combined Python checks pass. Shared candidate runs mkpmmqe4/tqpg7v99 each validate1260movements and complete display feedback: CPU p99 7.462/7.418ms (previous14.191); display interval p99 33.333292/16.666833ms. Platform input route isolation confirmed. Variable tail, limited workload coverage and source/host caveats prevent qualification. Later animation-pacing runs9l1mu3no/__xff2nq both validate1260 effects and complete display feedback: CPU p992.975/2.748ms, input-associated display p9925ms in both; still1119/1133 active frames without new input. These fail the display target. Source/host changes prevent isolated attribution; raw comparison is target/runtime-proof/animation-scheduling/comparison.json. Scrollbar-hold candidates e1bj0bmj/yzv25qln retain1260valid effects and complete feedback, cut non-input frames to67/68, but still25ms displayp99. Direct synthetic send-to-next-presented-frame p99 is32.801/35.416ms. Comparison: target/runtime-proof/scrollbar-hold/comparison.json.
